verdict.reason: The change-plan and yearly sections state the steps, that the same steps switch monthly to yearly, and that cancelling first is not needed.

steps.text: Go to Settings > Billing, click "View Billing Portal", then click the purple "Update subscription" button next to your current plan.
Select the plan you want to switch to, and to go yearly, pick the yearly option for that plan, then confirm the change.
You do not need to cancel your monthly subscription first.
